question.text: After re-tagging of an IA's benchmark or Strategy, the PM shall NOT use which of the following for performance reporting?

answer.text: Pre-re-tagging performance track record of that IA

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI specifically bars use of pre-re-tagging track record to avoid misleading attribution. The Trap: Post-re-tagging data is valid; benchmark and net returns remain reportable. Cross-Exam Context: Unique to SEBI (PM) Regs 2020 — highlighted in XXI-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep a clean 'performance since re-tagging' line in every factsheet.
